newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 1H car sales due Thursday - trade group.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 1H car sales due Thursday - trade group.

text.p: Malaysian motor sales figures for the first six months of 1997 will be released on Thursday at around 0200 GMT, the Malaysian Motor Traders Association said in an advisory.

The number of passenger vehicles sold from January to June 1996 totalled 118,552 units, a jump of 23 percent from the same period in 1995. The passenger vehicle figures included four-by-four wheel drives.
Commercial vehicle sales including fou-by-four wheel drives in the 1996 first six months amounted to 29,485 units.
